question: Can the 164-byte unmodified native probabilistic cell memory form, cold-restore and apply learned public transition and terminal-reward probabilities from 3x256 genuine previously consumed original DTR episodes, and how does retrospective held forecasting compare to independently fitted exact Bayesian, MLE and converged logistic conventional controls under identical source observations?

design.source_recovery: Losslessly re-encode 768 already consumed source FIT public tuples in 5-bit packed observed fields (S1,X1,S2,X2,Y), seed and original predetermined action pair by index; reconstruct exact original canonical fit-public-traces object and check both per-rep and aggregate original receipt SHA-256 before any training or scoring. No source import/reset/do, private state or original held VALID/DEV outcomes consumed.
design.train_test: For each of 3 already consumed replica FIT lists, train only prefix indices 0..31, 0..63, 0..127, or 0..191 (nested, not independent trials); fixed chronological held suffix indices 192..255 (64 per replica) never used for any fit, hyperparameter or source pin selection. Source is public development, not blind prospective experiment.
design.source_vis: Each FIT episode yields exactly two original public do observations: stage0 (S1,X1)->S2, stage1 (S1,X1,S2,X2)->Y. No outcome of unchosen action or post-episode private source variables. Terminal source after is None and never fabricated as real state.
design.native: Unmodified PublicCausalCells in NKR19. Slots 0,1 encode stage0 S1 and arm X1 -> observed S2; slots 2+4*S1+2*X1+S2 (2..9) encode stage1 state/history and arm X2 -> observed Y. 16 total physical slots, 7 active and 9 retained; correctly convert slot>=7 to retained addresses. Two sequential real-source publicly observed updates per fitted episode, 164-byte SHA-pinned cold state. No accepted model state and no architectural control replacement.
controls: independent exact Beta(1,1) batch probability fitted from identical FIT rows, expected parity
independent fully fitted MLE frequencies with .5 prior only for missing support

fully fitted conventional logistic parametric binary model for two separate targets, fixed public features/interactions, fixed initial zero, fixed l2=0.001, batch gradient up to 3000 iterations with predeclared convergence threshold1e-8, no SCM law or held tuning
design.test: Each frozen prefix model predicts stage0 S2 and stage1 terminal Y of every held 64 original source FIT suffix per replica, total 3*4*64*2=1536 scored binary forecasts PER arm; charge no new original effects, report each target separately and pooled exact Brier, learning cost/bytes and cold parity. Never call this executed changed learned-policy reward or new causal-family transfer.
design.retention: Verify each native snapshot cold roundtrip byte exactly; earlier smaller FIT prefix results must be identical to recomputed prefix snapshots even after later standalone longer FIT models, but this is independent fork, not proven same-address continual interference. Also check same native model incremental observations vs from-scratch exact deterministic 164-byte parity.
design.negative: Duplicate source event identities, forged source artifact hashes, out-of-range public bits, wrong seed/order/actions and contaminated held inputs must be refused before fit; exact control must tie native result at 1536 predictions or FAIL. Held outcomes never enter any candidate/controls until scoring.
design.primary_gate: SOURCEFREE_AUTHENTIC_CONSUMED_DTR_DEVELOPMENT_SUPPORTED only if custody parity + native/exact Beta all predictions parity + cold exact + all denominators; diagnose numeric utility but no hard performance gain required. SCIENTIFIC_PASS ALWAYS FALSE; any claimed superiority over exact equivalent must be treated as error.
